description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller that provides a fallback for unmapped paths, returning a standardized 404 JSON response instead of default errors, and excluding certain paths like API, actuator, and documentation endpoints.

classes.name: NotFoundFallbackController
classes.description: A REST controller that handles all unmapped requests by returning a 404 response with additional request info, except for certain whitelisted paths.

methods.name: notFound
methods.description: Handles all unmatched paths, returning a detailed 404 JSON response unless the path is explicitly whitelisted.

methods.name: startsWithAny
methods.description: Helper method that checks if the request path starts with any of the specified prefixes.
